summary:
Hello everyone! We are Team NAJEM from Saudi Arabia. Our project, Aegis-BioSpace, is an offline health guardian for astronauts.

In space, help may be far away, but emergencies cannot wait.

Our system monitors five body systems, detects danger, and guides astronauts through simple voice instructions.

Powered by NASA data, it detects health risks and protects medical records.

Our goal is to make space travel safer, from the Moon to Mars and beyond.

Because no astronaut should ever be alone when their life is at risk.

Thank you!
details:
Slide 1: Title Hello everyone. We are team NAJEM, The Star, from Al Khobar and Dammam, Saudi Arabia. Our project is Aegis-BioSpace. It is health monitoring software for astronauts, and it works completely offline. Slide 2: The Problem When astronauts travel to the Moon or Mars, a message to Earth can take up to 40 minutes. In a medical emergency, they cannot wait. In space, many problems happen at the same time. Too much CO2 in the air gives headaches. Kidney stones are the number two reason for medical evacuation. And sleep becomes very short. Also, today astronauts see complicated charts. A tired, dizzy astronaut cannot read them. They need one clear action.

Slide 3: Our Solution (30 sec) Our solution is a simple cockpit. The astronaut sees a body avatar with five systems: brain, heart, blood, bones and kidneys, and lungs. Green means normal. Orange means early warning. Red means danger. The app speaks the steps out loud, and the astronaut only needs the Spacebar to confirm. We also added a ten-second reaction test to check if the astronaut is tired. Slide 4: How It Works How does it work? Step one: we use real NASA equations, for example how much CO2 a person produces. Step two: the app finds the real cause, so high CO2 is not confused with stress or anxiety. Step three: it gives simple first-level help, like checking the air scrubbers, and starts a timer. If the astronaut does not get better, it moves to level two, with medicine advice adjusted for radiation damage. Step four: every action is saved in a secure chain, so cosmic rays or hackers cannot change the data.

Slide 5: NASA Data Everything is based on official NASA sources: the standards for CO2, radiation, kidney health, sleep, and the space pharmacy plan. Slide 6: Results We tested our prototype offline. In our reaction test, rested team members were between 262 and 294 milliseconds. When we simulated tiredness, it jumped to 438, and the app started light therapy. Then we simulated a cosmic ray changing a medical record. The app found the change in less than one millisecond and repaired the data automatically. Slide 7: Impact and Thank You Aegis-BioSpace can help astronauts on Artemis and Mars missions. It can also help on Earth: in submarines, polar stations, and disaster zones with no internet. Our next step is to connect it to real medical devices and sensors. Thank you for listening.
